app.name: Files
app.signOutFailed: Signing out didn’t work: {reason} You’re still signed in.
app.offline: You’re offline. Files and folders load again once the connection is back.
app.actionLost: Your session had expired and you’re signed in again. Your last action was not carried out; do it again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist in “Files”.

shareTarget.title: Save shared files
shareTarget.intro: Choose the folder in “My storage” for the shared file. | Choose the folder in “My storage” for the {count} shared files.
shareTarget.missing: Nothing to save here. Either the files were already saved, or the share did not reach “Files”: open “Files” once, then share again.
shareTarget.outside: These files came from outside “Files”: another app or a website can send them. Check each name and size (the type is what the sender states); nothing is saved until you choose “Save here”.
shareTarget.refused: This share came from a website, not from your device’s share menu, so “Files” did not accept it. Nothing was saved.

signedOut.title: Signed out
signedOut.text: You’ve signed out of “Files” on this device. Your shard keeps you signed in to its other apps.

webdav.heading: Network drive (WebDAV)
webdav.intro: Connect your storage on the shard as a network drive: in Finder, in Windows Explorer or with other programs. Sign in there with an app password, not with your shard password.
webdav.username: User name: any name you like. The app password tells the shard who you are.

appPasswords.heading: App passwords
appPasswords.label: Device or program
appPasswords.invalid: Enter a name for the device or program.
appPasswords.revokeMessage: Devices and programs that sign in with this app password lose access at once. You can create a new one at any time.
appPasswords.shownText: Enter this password in the device or program, together with the address. You can see it only now: if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
appPasswords.copyManually: The password is selected: copy it with Ctrl + C or ⌘ + C.

storage.title: Storage usage
storage.noClouds: You have not connected a cloud account yet.
storage.cloudUnknown: Usage unknown: the provider gives no figures for this storage

members.title: Members
members.intro: Everyone who has signed in to “Files” at least once. A storage limit caps what a member can store on the shard: files, trash, versions and uploads in progress. Nothing already stored is removed.
members.invalid: Enter a size of 0 or more.
members.saved: The storage limit for {name} is now {quota}.

connections.title: Cloud accounts
connections.intro: Connect your own cloud accounts. Only you see them; the files stay with the provider and are shown live.
connections.empty: You have not connected a cloud account yet.

status.unavailable: No longer offered on this shard

connections.unlinkMessage: Shared items and public links from this account stop working, even if you connect it again later. Your files stay with {provider}; to revoke the access completely, remove it in your {provider} account settings.
connections.noProviders: No cloud provider is set up on this shard yet.

library.title: Choose a SharePoint library
library.intro: Choose the document library this connection of {account} shows. You can connect more libraries later.
library.noLibraries: This site has no document library.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.empty: No favourites yet. Star files and folders in any of your places to find them here.
favourites.failedHeading: The favourite could not be changed:

recent.title: Recent
recent.empty: Nothing here yet. Files you upload, copy, move, rename or restore will show up here.

search.label: Search files by name
search.empty: Nothing found with “{query}” in its name.
search.more: {source} has more matches. Type more of the name to narrow them down.

folder.emptyHome: Nothing here yet. Upload your first files.
folder.notFoundText: This folder does not exist, or no longer does.
folder.newFolderPrompt: What should the folder be called?
folder.invalid: A name can’t be empty, contain “/” or be “.” or “..”.

upload.dropHint: Drop files or folders to upload them to {folder}.

collision.title: Name already taken
collision.message: “{name}” already exists here. What should happen?
collision.applyAll: Do this for all remaining items ({count})

rename.title: Rename
rename.label: New name
rename.invalid: A name can’t be empty, contain “/” or be “.” or “..”.
rename.tooLong: The name is too long: at most 255 characters, and accented letters and symbols count twice or more.

transfer.markedMove: One item ready to move. Open the target folder and choose “Move here”. | {count} items ready to move. Open the target folder and choose “Move here”.
transfer.markedCopy: One item ready to copy. Open the target folder and choose “Copy here”. | {count} items ready to copy. Open the target folder and choose “Copy here”.
transfer.trashed: One item moved to the trash | {count} items moved to the trash

trash.title: Trash
trash.retention: Deleted items are kept for one day, then deleted permanently. | Deleted items are kept for {days} days, then deleted permanently.
trash.usage: {size} in the trash, counted towards your storage.
trash.confirmEmptyMessage: The item in the trash will be deleted permanently. This can’t be undone. | All {count} items in the trash will be deleted permanently. This can’t be undone.
trash.confirmDeleteMessage: “{name}” will be deleted permanently. This can’t be undone.

share.title: Share “{name}”
share.noMembers: There are no other members yet. Members appear here after they first sign in.
share.pickMember: Choose a member from the list.

shared.title: Shared with me
shared.empty: Nothing has been shared with you yet.

link.heading: Public links
link.none: No public link yet. Anyone with a public link can open the item without signing in.
link.label: Label
link.labelHint: Only you see it, e.g. who the link is for
link.limitHint: Leave empty for no limit; 0 allows no downloads. Previews count as downloads.
link.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
link.copyManually: The address is selected. Copy it with your keyboard or the context menu.
link.downloads: no downloads yet | one download | {count} downloads
link.orphaned: No longer available: the item was deleted.

page.passwordPrompt: This link is protected by a password.
page.countNote: Every download and every preview counts towards the limit of this link.
page.notFound: This link does not exist, or no longer does. Ask the person who sent it to you.

requests.title: File requests
requests.intro: A file request lets anyone with its address send you files into one folder, without seeing what is in it.
requests.label: Title
requests.labelHint: Shown to the people you send it to, e.g. what you are asking for
requests.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
requests.askName: Ask senders for their name (they may leave it empty)
requests.copyManually: The address is selected. Copy it with your keyboard or the context menu.
requests.received: no files yet | one file | {count} files
requests.isOrphaned: No longer available: the folder was deleted.

page.intro: Send files to the person who shared this page with you. You only see the files you send here.
page.passwordPrompt: This file request is protected by a password.
page.name: Your name (optional)
page.none: You have not sent any files yet.
page.unavailable: This file request can’t be opened
page.notFound: This file request does not exist, or no longer does. Ask the person who sent it to you.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: You are no longer signed in.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that.
errors.CSRF: That didn’t work, for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist, or no longer does.
errors.FILE_EXISTS: An item with this name already exists.
errors.PATH_INVALID: This name or path is not allowed.
errors.PATH_SYMLINK: Shortcuts are not opened, for security reasons.
errors.IS_A_DIRECTORY: This is a folder, not a file.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file type is not accepted here.
errors.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE: The file could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: This place doesn’t exist or isn’t available to you.
errors.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The file was changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.SIZE_MISMATCH: The upload was incomplete. Try again.
errors.LOGIN_FAILED: Signing in didn’t work. Try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again later.
errors.TARGET_INSIDE_SOURCE: A folder can’t be moved or copied into itself.
errors.PURGE_FAILED: One item could not be deleted permanently. It stays in the trash. Try again later. | {count} items could not be deleted permanently. They stay in the trash. Try again later.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: There isn’t enough space left in your storage.
errors.OFFSET_MISMATCH: The upload got out of step with the shard. Try again.
errors.UPLOAD_LOCKED: This upload is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
errors.NO_THUMBNAIL: There is no thumbnail for this file type.
errors.THUMBNAIL_FAILED: The thumbnail could not be created.
errors.SEARCH_FAILED: The search at this provider failed.
errors.SHARE_ORPHANED: This shared item is gone: the person who shared it has deleted it.
errors.INVALID_EXPIRY: This expiry is not valid. Choose a date and time in the future.
errors.DOWNLOAD_LIMIT_REACHED: This link has no downloads left.
errors.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter the password of this link first.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.CONNECT_FAILED: The account could not be connected. Try again.
errors.CONNECT_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: You signed in with a different account. Sign in with the account of this connection, or connect the other account as well.
errors.CONNECTION_REAUTH: The cloud provider no longer accepts the sign-in. Sign in again under “Cloud accounts”.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The cloud provider cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_NAME: Several items in this folder are called “{name}”. Open the folder again and pick one.
errors.NOT_EXPORTABLE: This document type can’t be downloaded. Open it at the cloud provider.
errors.LIBRARY_ALREADY_CONNECTED: This library is already connected. Choose another one.
errors.VERIFY_FAILED: The copy could not be verified: what arrived does not match what was sent. The original stays where it was.
errors.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: This needs your confirmation first. Start it again and confirm.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: Changed in the cloud since the migration, so it was kept.
errors.COPY_CHANGED: The copy on the shard was changed, moved or deleted, so the original was kept.
errors.APP_PASSWORD_LIMIT: You can have at most {max} app passwords. Revoke one you no longer use first.
errors.LOCK_LIMIT: Your WebDAV clients hold {max} locks, the most there can be. Unlock files you no longer edit first.
errors.LINK_UNAVAILABLE: This link can’t be opened right now. Try again later.
errors.LINK_REVOKED: The person who sent you this link has closed it.
errors.REQUEST_FILE_LIMIT: This file request accepts no more files.
errors.REQUEST_SIZE_LIMIT: This file is larger than the space left in this file request.

versions.title: Versions
versions.none: No earlier versions yet. Whenever the file is replaced, the previous content is kept here.
versions.restored: The version from {date} was restored. The content it replaced is kept as a version.

sort.label: Sort by
sort.failed: The sort order could not be saved.

preview.failed: The preview could not be loaded. You can still download the file.
preview.unsupported: This file type can’t be shown here. Download the file to open it.
preview.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {size}. Download the file to see all of it.

started.copy: Copying one item; the progress is under “Transfers”. | Copying {count} items; the progress is under “Transfers”.
started.move: Moving one item; the progress is under “Transfers”. | Moving {count} items; the progress is under “Transfers”.

transfers.nothingToDo: Nothing pasted: every item was skipped.

migrate.title: Move to the shard
migrate.intro: Copy a cloud folder or a whole account onto the shard in one go. Every file is checked when it arrives. Afterwards you can delete the verified originals from the cloud.
migrate.name: Name of the new folder
migrate.nameNote: A new folder is created for the migration. If the name is taken, it gets a number.
migrate.atLeast: At least this much: counting stopped early. The migration copies everything.

summary.title: Summary
summary.cancelled: The migration was cancelled; what is verified stays on the shard.

cleanup.title: Originals in the cloud
cleanup.intro: Delete the verified files from {account}. They go to the provider’s trash. Files that failed to move or changed since the migration stay.
cleanup.nothing: There are no verified files to delete.
cleanup.confirmMessage: One verified file ({size}) will be deleted from {account} and go to its trash. Files that failed to move or changed since the migration stay. | {count} verified files ({size}) will be deleted from {account} and go to its trash. Files that failed to move or changed since the migration stay.
cleanup.progressLabel: Progress of deleting the originals of {name}

actions.arrows: Move between the items of the list
actions.galleryArrows: Move between the tiles of the gallery
actions.homeEnd: Go to the first or last item
actions.open: Open the folder or preview the file
actions.paste: Move or copy the marked items here
actions.history: Back or forward in the folder history, also with the mouse’s side buttons
